config.assignment: fixed sorted source-profile order, index modulo three

checkpoint_contract.crossing: first complete iteration crossing each work threshold; record previous count and overshoot; iteration labels exact; keep axes separate; coalesce simultaneous labels without changing training
checkpoint_contract.export: observation only; exact arrays/RNG/work equal uninterrupted training; finite canonical gzip JSON mtime0, hash and byte-exact policy round trip

config.forecast: fixed three-worker training sums plus six checkpoints per future cell at maximum own-score/roundtrip cost over all four source profiles and three repeats for that game/representation; charge scoring twice for in-run plus report replay; add measured setup/collection and full-size serialization/render fixture cost, then 2x; native projection separate

metric_contract.exact_exploitability_chips: half sum of target best-response gains; zero-sum signs explicit
metric_contract.extra_information_gap_chips: half sum of exact minus restricted reply values; exact exploitability equals within plus extra
metric_contract.positive_average_coverage: fraction of partition rows with positive stored average mass; warm exact initialization can make this one immediately
metric_contract.regret_norm: L2 norm over all stored regret entries
metric_contract.river_only_gain_exact_prefix_chips: half sum of exact reply value minus exact-turn/restricted-river own hybrid value against fixed saved opponent; nonnegative, not retraining gain
metric_contract.river_visit_coverage: fraction of river partition keys read by external passes, excluding exact initialization; full traversal visits every row; return null for no river rows
metric_contract.value_player_zero_chips: exact policy value in target chips for seat0
metric_contract.within_partition_gain_chips: half sum of restricted reply value minus saved target value
